Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0035 1. Remark 2.2\group generalized-fixed-points

If the soliton vector field is a gradient field $X=- abla f$, then the soliton equation becomes $ abla abla f=\Rc +\lambda g$, and the metric is called a gradient Ricci soliton.
